comment: Least-privilege roles for the SiliconBox database. Read by create-app-role.js (mongosh) and atlas-roles.mjs (Atlas). Deliberately absent from siliconboxApp: answers, drill_privates and assessment_keys (hidden material; Payload stores the drill_private collection under that plural name), the migration collections, and update/remove on audit_log (append-only). siliconboxGrader reads drill_privates and assessment_keys only, to grade Drill runs (ADR 0021) and assessments (ADR 0029).
